newsitem.title: SINGAPORE:Singapore bunker final report and prices- Nov 12.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunker final report and prices- Nov 12.

text.p: DELIVERED U.S.$/TONNE) 380 CST 180 CST MDO GAS OIL

COMMENTS - Bunker prices were firmer in line with higher prices in the western markets, traders said on Tuesday. They said crude gains on Friday have sparked off a price rise in Rotterdam which have in turn triggered higher prices in Asia. While price quotes were higher, bids were very low, traders said. They said buyers appeared unhurried to cover their requirements. Demand was thin, said a trader. --Singapore Newsoom (65-870-3082).
